Home Network Setup

A tidy network corner is easier to troubleshoot when the signal drops. Labels on cables save time later, even in a small apartment setup.

Keep the modem and router in an open spot instead of hiding them behind a television stand. Better airflow and fewer walls can improve coverage right away.

If a device feels slow, restart the connection chain one step at a time. That simple habit often reveals whether the issue is local or shared.
